sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content:
Welcome to Vastu. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Vastu website, mobile application, and any related services (collectively, the "Platform") operated by Vastu Rentals Private Limited ("we", "us", or "our").

By accessing or using our Platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility
sections.content: You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into binding contracts to use Vastu. By using our Platform, you represent and warrant that you meet these requirements.

sections.title: 3. User Accounts
sections.content: To access certain features, you may need to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

sections.title: 4. Listings and Bookings
sections.content:
Users can list items for rent and book items listed by others. We do not own the items listed on Vastu and act solely as an intermediary between users.

We reserve the right to remove any listing or user that violates these Terms or our policies.

sections.title: 5. Payments and Fees
sections.content:
All payments must be made through our secure payment system. We may charge service fees for certain transactions, which will be clearly displayed before you complete a booking.

You agree to pay all applicable fees and taxes.

sections.title: 6. Cancellations and Refunds
sections.content: Cancellation policies and refund eligibility are governed by the terms specified at the time of booking. Users must resolve disputes through Vastu support in alignment with our formal Refund Policy.

sections.title: 7. User Conduct
sections.content: Users agree to behave professionally, not list prohibited items, and not bypass Vastu's secure system or direct transactions off-platform. Any attempt to negotiate or transact off-platform will lead to account suspension.

sections.title: 9. Limitation of Liability

sections.title: 11. Changes to Terms

sections.title: 12. Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of India, without regard to its conflict of law provisions. All disputes are subject to exclusive jurisdiction in Bengaluru.

sections.title: 13. Contact Us
